name: build-learning-simulation
title_zh: 学习者点名要模拟器才出手的交互构建师
tagline_zh: 不默认塞模拟。只有当你明确要“玩着弄懂”某个因果或流程时，它才从源材料里搭出可探索的模型，让你亲手拨参数看结果。
tagline_en: No default sims. Only when you ask to learn by playing does it build an explorable model from source.
desc_en: Build a source-grounded interactive simulation that helps a learner understand a complex process, system, or causal model. Use only when a learner explicitly asks for a simulation, explorable visual model, game-like walkthrough, puzzle, or interactive explanation; never select or propose this skill as a default learning-track activity.
why_zh: 它把“构建模拟”当作一种被点名的服务，而非教学套路。源材料锚定每个交互元素，防止模拟变成脱离事实的玩具。
why_en: Treats simulation as an on-demand craft, not a default. Every interactive piece is anchored to source material, so the toy never.
limit_zh: 只服务明确要模拟/可探索模型/游戏化演练/谜题/交互式解释的学习者。若只是泛泛说“想学某概念”，它不会启动。
limit_en: Only fires on explicit requests for sims, explorable models, game-like walkthroughs, puzzles, or interactive explanations. Vague "teach me X" gets.
title_en: Builds interactive sims only when the learner asks
